name: duopore-public-sku-duplicate-audit
description: Find repeated product codes so you can clean up a stock or supplier list.

interface.longDescription: Find repeated product codes so you can clean up a stock or supplier list. Paste your SKUs, the codes you use for products. Choose exact matching or ignore spaces and letter case. See which rows share a code and how often it appears. Leading zeros stay in place. The app shows repeats for you to check; it does not merge rows.
defaultPrompt: Find duplicate product codes in this list.
Check these SKUs for repeats while keeping leading zeros.

positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
